privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.sent.label: Sent to the internet since setup
privacy.sent.label.unmeasured: What Nocturne uses the internet for
privacy.headline.awayOn: Only downloads you agreed to, and Away from home.
privacy.sent.unmeasured.detail: This computer can’t count what leaves it, so Nocturne lists every download below instead.
privacy.ago.seconds: {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} ago
privacy.ago.minutes: {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} ago
privacy.ledger.heading: Downloaded, with your say-so
privacy.promise: Nocturne has no account, no analytics and no crash reports. Once set up, Nocturne works without the internet. Away from home, if you turn it on, uses Cloudflare or Tailscale to reach your phone.
privacy.here.heading: On this computer
privacy.export.title: Export everything
privacy.export.body: A folder of readable files: every memory as text, every page, and all your originals, exactly as kept.
privacy.export.counts: {memories, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}}, {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} and {originals, plural, one {# original} other {# originals}}.
privacy.export.failed: The export didn’t finish. Nothing was changed. Try again.
privacy.delete.title: Delete everything
privacy.delete.body: Removes all you kept, all memories and all pages. Export first if you might want them.
privacy.delete.dialog.title: Delete everything?
privacy.delete.dialog.body: This removes everything Nocturne holds from this computer: what you kept, what it remembers and every page. It can’t be undone.
privacy.delete.failed: That didn’t finish. Nothing was deleted. Try again in a moment.
privacy.error: Nocturne couldn’t open this. What you kept is safe.
privacy.sent.awayOn.detail: This computer can’t tell Nocturne what it sends. While Away from home is on, Nocturne also talks to your phones through {company}. What goes to them is counted here.
privacy.phones.label: Sent to your phones
privacy.phones.counted: Counted by Nocturne as it leaves this computer
privacy.away.heading: Away from home
privacy.away.phonesBring: Your phones can bring their calendar and health readings, in the same locked messages.
privacy.away.on.simple: Away from home is on. Your phones reach this computer through Cloudflare. What you ask and keep is locked so Cloudflare can’t read it. Cloudflare can see when, from where and how much. Nothing goes anywhere else.
privacy.away.on.mostPrivate: Away from home is on. Your phones reach this computer through Tailscale. What you ask and keep is locked so Tailscale can’t read it. Tailscale can see that they connect, and when. Nothing goes anywhere else.
privacy.away.lastOn: Away from home is off. It was last on {when}.
privacy.away.simple.see2: Your phone’s internet address, and roughly where it is
privacy.away.simple.see3: How much goes back and forth, each way
privacy.away.simple.see4: It serves the page your phone opens, and a change it made could stay on your phone until you add the phone again
privacy.away.simple.see5: A stable id for each phone, and the size and timing of every message
privacy.away.mostPrivate.see1: That your phone and computer are connected, and when
privacy.away.mostPrivate.see3: How much goes back and forth, if a network stops them reaching each other directly
privacy.away.never.heading: Never on a phone
privacy.away.never.body: Things you marked private stay on this computer.
privacy.away.risks.heading: Worth knowing
privacy.away.risks.phone: Anyone holding an unlocked or stolen phone can read everything not marked private until you remove that phone here.
privacy.away.risks.code: If a pairing code leaks, from a photo, a screen share or an online QR scanner, only comparing the three words stops it.
privacy.away.risks.local: In Simple, anyone using this computer can see the public address. It doesn’t let them in.
privacy.sent.awayOn.measured: Nocturne can’t count what the connection part itself sends to {company}. What goes to your phones is counted here.
privacy.headline.onlineOn: Only downloads you agreed to, and online answers.
privacy.headline.awayAndOnline: Only downloads you agreed to, Away from home, and online answers.
privacy.sent.unmeasured.detail.online: This computer can’t count what leaves it, so Nocturne lists every download below, and counts each question it sends online.
privacy.online.label: Sent for online answers
privacy.online.amount.on: {size} in {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}
privacy.online.counted: Counted by Nocturne, question by question.
privacy.online.heading: Online answers
privacy.online.on: Online answers are on. Your questions, and the few things that answer them, go from Nocturne’s engine on this computer to your provider ({host}). Nothing else is sent.
privacy.online.off: Online answers are off. Questions are answered on this computer.
privacy.online.keeps: Nocturne can’t check what your provider keeps. Its own privacy page says.
privacy.promise.online: Nocturne has no account, no analytics and no crash reports. Once set up, Nocturne works without the internet. Away from home, if you turn it on, uses Cloudflare or Tailscale to reach your phone. Online answers, if you turn them on, send your question and the few things needed to answer it to your provider.
privacy.export.body.online: A folder of readable files: every memory as text, every page, all your originals exactly as kept, and the list of what was sent online. Never the key.
privacy.delete.dialog.online: This also forgets the key for your provider ({host}) on this computer, and the list of what was sent online.
